title: Deconstructing NLG Evaluation: Evaluation Practices, Assumptions, and Their Implications
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure anything specific in terms of faith or religion. Its focus was on the general practices, assumptions, and ethical considerations (like fairness and inclusion) in NLG evaluation, without specifying religious contexts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study.
